title: Grow Little Bunny B2: the outline-gray look (screen-space edge pass, chroma rule, blob shadows)
body:
The npr.outline-gray.v1 presentation: a screen-space line pass over depth, normals and object ids, flat gray fills, colour only on chroma materials (checked in tests), blob shadows, line fade with distance, and Low/Medium/High tiers, with captures per tier.

Spec: docs/verse/games/grow-little-bunny.md (Milestones, B2).
